activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1886, when Karl Benz applied for the patent for his gas-engine-powered vehicle and publicly demonstrated the Patent Motor Car, as his representative German automotive-engineering milestone.

sources.title: Benz Patent Motor Car: The first automobile (1885–1886) — Mercedes-Benz Group
sources.citation_text: Mercedes-Benz records Benz's patent application for the gas-engine-powered vehicle on 29 January 1886 and the vehicle's first public outing that year.
